intro.t: I’m Elise, founder, planner and the person behind Honey it’s Handled.

believe.t: I believe the best events aren’t the ones where you notice how perfectly everything is organised. They’re the ones where you don’t have to think about it at all.

years.t: Before starting Honey it’s Handled, I spent 5 years managing events and bringing together people, suppliers, timings, budgets and approximately a thousand moving parts.

pinterest.t: Whether there’s already a date, a Pinterest board with 847 pins or simply an idea you can’t stop thinking about, I’d love to hear about it.

pro.text: On May 25th, 2026, the Handelsbeurs in Antwerp set the stage for the Pro League Awards, bringing together over 570 guests to celebrate the very best of Belgian football.
